'''Musk''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. They were part of a group that were stranded on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[4 BBY]] following an attack on the brigade. 

==Biography==
By [[4 BBY]], Musk had joined the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] to fight against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the brigade was attacked and Musk was apart of a group of at least sixteen members of the brigade that escaped aboard a [[starship]] that landed on [[Yavin 4]]. However [[Bardi's brother|one member]] of the group subsequently departed in the ship leaving Musk and the rest of the group stranded on the [[moon]]. An altercation occurred between the brigade members and an individual named [[Porko]] that they found near a clearing with a damaged [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]] which resulted in the [[death]] of Porko.<ref name="One Year Later" />

Two [[Standard day|days]] after being stranded on the moon, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] landed in the clearing with a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]] that he was going to hand off to Porko. As Andor approached the group announced their presence with [[blaster]]s drawn and took Andor prisoner. Musk watched as two members of the group [[Gerdis]] and [[Bardi]] took turns trying to interrogate Andor. Once [[Rika]], a member of the group, found the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[pilot]] [[helmet]] in the TIE, the group drew their weapons on Andor again. Later on Musk waited outside the TIE while Rika tried to learn to fly it. After realizing it was a lot more complicated to fly due being a prototype the group discussed the situation before Andor interrupted the group once again trying to convince them to trust him.<ref name="One Year Later" /> 

[[File:Musk-SagronaTeema.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Musk with melon]]
That night, an argument between the group erupted when discussing who should be in charge ultimately coming to a head when [[Crab]] shoot Rika with his blaster and [[Rowd]] responds by shooting Crab. The brigade members exchange fire while splitting into two factions; with Musk siding with Bardi, [[Nazy]], Rowd, [[Tick (individual)|Tick]], [[Neek]] and [[Flu]] and regrouping at the TIE while the other group retreats to the crashed HOY-39.<ref name="One Year Later" /> The following morning the group cut open a fowl smelling [[Yavin 4 melon]]. While discussing whether to eat the it, Musk suggested Flu should eat it because he ate [[Trog-beast|trog]]s on a dare before Bardi musters up the courage and takes a bite. Later in day the group began trying to use rope to rotate the TIE so that its weapons would point towards the other group. During the attempt, Musk assisted by using a tree branch to gain leverage. When they found out about the move they opened fire at the TIE forcing the Musk's group to suspend their attempts. <ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref>

That night Gerdis decided to issue a challenge to Bardi to settle the dispute. The two groups cross towards each other before all dropping their weapons in unison. Musk held a torch as they watched the two leaders engage in a game of [[Five Hands]] with [[Roski rules]]. While the group watched Andor escaped his captured and made his way to the ship before he could get there a [[Yavinian doodar]] came out of the [[jungle]] and scooped Bardi and Gerdis in it's mouth. The rest of the group, including Musk scrambled for their guns and began to shoot wildly into the jungle. When the group realized that Andor had made it to the TIE and was taking off they began shooting at it but were unable to stop it from leaving.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Personality and traits==
Musk had tan skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s and black [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
While stranded on Yavin 4 Musk wore a yellow [[flight suit]] and carried a [[blaster rifle]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
Musk was portrayed by [[Akie Kotabe ]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's first and second episodes, "[[One Year Later]]" and "[[Sagrona Teema]]," which were both released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
